target.title: fix(codex): preserve JSONL framing across WebSocket writes
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes the Codex WebSocket transport's handling of valid Writable inputs that split UTF-8 bytes or JSONL records across writes.

The current Codex app-server client writes each complete JSON-RPC record and trailing newline in one `stdin.write()` call. This change is defensive adapter contract hardening rather than a reproduction of a failure in that current caller.

## Why This Change Was Made

Codex 0.144.5 uses newline-delimited JSON on stdio and one complete JSON-RPC message per WebSocket text frame. The WebSocket adapter exposes a Writable input, so it must preserve UTF-8 decoder state and JSONL record boundaries across arbitrary writes before producing message-oriented WebSocket frames.

The adapter now incrementally decodes UTF-8, retains incomplete JSONL records between writes, sends each completed record as one WebSocket text frame, and flushes a complete unterminated final record when the Writable finishes.

## User Impact

The current one-write-per-message client path is unchanged. Alternate or future callers using valid split Writable writes no longer receive replacement characters or partial WebSocket frames.

## Evidence

- Contract-level live proof used the exact pinned Codex 0.144.5 Darwin arm64 app-server with isolated localhost state. An `initialize` request was intentionally written through `createWebSocketTransport().stdin` as two byte chunks split after 2 of the emoji's 4 UTF-8 bytes. Codex returned a valid response with id 1.

  ```json
  {
    "codexVersion": "0.144.5",
    "requestMethod": "initialize",
    "utf8Marker": "😀",
    "splitAfterBytes": 2,
    "responseId": 1,
    "responseHasResult": true,
    "isolatedCodexHome": true,
    "transportPath": "OpenClaw Writable bridge to Codex WebSocket app-server"
  }
  ```

- Caller inspection confirmed `CodexAppServerClient.writeMessage()` currently performs one complete JSONL write per message; no production stream pipe or byte-chunk writer was found.
- Direct Codex 0.144.5 contract inspection confirmed stdio JSONL framing and one JSON-RPC message per WebSocket text frame in `codex-rs/app-server/README.md` and the stdio/WebSocket transport implementations.
- Extension-specific test: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/transport-websocket.test.ts`: 1 file passed, 4 tests passed, covering split UTF-8 writes and finalization of an unterminated record.
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.extensions.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/extensions.tsbuildinfo`: passed.
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.extensions.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/extensions-test.tsbuildinfo`: passed.
- Targeted extension `oxlint`: passed for the two transport files and regression test.
- Targeted `oxfmt --check`: all 3 changed files use the correct format.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD`: passed.
